item.stem:
The diagram shows Tanvi's triangular garden plot. The side lengths are $4\,\mathrm{m}$, $9\,\mathrm{m}$, and $11\,\mathrm{m}$.

Which claim correctly gives the perimeter of the plot?

options.B: Perimeter $= 11\,\mathrm{m}$, taking the longest side length as the perimeter.
options.C: Each side equals $24\,\mathrm{m}$, because the perimeter produces each side.
options.D: Perimeter $= 3\,\mathrm{m}$, because a triangle is named by having three sides.
